Zenith Pillar.name: Zenith Pillar
Zenith Pillar.description: The user's signature move: every bit of heat gathers into a white star between the palms, then leaves as a pillar of flame wide enough to fill a street. It deals massive fire damage to everything along its line and burns through any armor or barrier in the way; afterward the user cannot make flame until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
